name: Casual Daywear
desc: Comfortable jeans and tees. Best for everyday outings. Pair with sneakers or flats. Suits rectangular, pear, and apple body types.

name: Office Formal
desc: Blazers, trousers, and skirts for professional settings. Opt for tailored cuts to complement hourglass or rectangular body types. Pair with heels or loafers.

name: Party Wear
desc: Stylish dresses or tops for evening events. Flowy or fitted silhouettes work best depending on body type. Pair with heels or statement flats.

name: Traditional Attire
desc: Sarees, kurtas, and ethnic wear. Best suited for festivals and ceremonies. Pear and hourglass body types often suit drapes. Pair with ethnic footwear.

name: Travel Outfits
desc: Comfortable and versatile clothes for vacations. Prefer breathable fabrics. Works for all body types. Pair with sneakers or sandals.

name: Winter Layers
desc: Sweaters, jackets, and scarves for cold weather. Layered looks suit tall and rectangular body types. Pair with boots or loafers.

name: Shirts
desc: Button-down shirts for formal or semi-formal occasions. Slim fit suits rectangular and tall body types. Pair with trousers or jeans and loafers.

name: T-Shirts
desc: Casual tees in solid or printed styles. Works with all body types. Pair with jeans, shorts, or skirts and sneakers.

name: Crop Tops
desc: Trendy cropped tops best for hourglass and petite body types. Pair with high-waist pants or skirts and sneakers or heels.

name: Kurtis
desc: Indian casual or semi-formal wear. Suits pear and rectangular body types. Pair with leggings, palazzos, or skirts and sandals or ethnic footwear.

name: Dresses
desc: Midi, maxi, or A-line dresses for outings. Hourglass and rectangular body types look best. Pair with heels, flats, or sandals depending on occasion.

name: Sarees
desc: Traditional drapes in silk, cotton, or designer fabrics. Pear and hourglass body types suit sarees best. Pair with heels or wedges.

name: Lehengas
desc: Festive and bridal wear with embroidery. Best for hourglass and rectangular figures. Pair with heels or wedges.

name: Blazers
desc: Formal jackets for office or semi-casual looks. Slim fit enhances rectangular and hourglass body types. Pair with trousers and loafers.

name: Hoodies
desc: Casual pullovers for relaxed and winter fashion. Works for all body types. Pair with jeans and sneakers.

name: Jeans
desc: Denim in slim, straight, and relaxed fits. Tailor fit depending on body type. Works for all genders. Pair with tees, shirts, hoodies, or blazers.

name: Handbags
desc: Trendy and functional bags. Best suited for casual, office, or party outfits. Choose medium-sized bags for daily use and clutches for parties.
styleTip: Neutral tones work with most outfits; bright colors for statement look.

name: Belts
desc: Classic and statement belts to enhance your outfit. Slim belts suit formal wear; wide belts accentuate dresses or kurtis.
styleTip: Match belt color with shoes or handbag for a cohesive look.

name: Watches
desc: Elegant timepieces that blend function and fashion. Leather straps suit formal attire; metal or sporty straps for casual wear.
styleTip: Choose watch size proportional to your wrist.

name: Necklaces
desc: Delicate chains to bold statement pieces. Short chains suit formal blouses; long or chunky necklaces enhance dresses or kurtis.
styleTip: Coordinate necklace style with neckline of your outfit.

name: Earrings
desc: Studs, hoops, and danglers for every mood. Small studs for office, statement earrings for parties, traditional jhumkas for ethnic wear.
styleTip: Balance earrings with hairstyle and outfit neckline.

name: Sunglasses
desc: Protect your eyes while staying stylish. Aviators suit oval faces; round frames suit square faces. Best for casual and travel wear.
styleTip: Choose frame shape complementing your face shape.

name: Bracelets
desc: From minimal bangles to chunky wristwear. Thin bracelets for office, layered or chunky for parties or casual wear.
styleTip: Mix metals or colors for a playful look, but avoid overcrowding.

name: Scarves
desc: Printed, wool, or silk scarves for style and comfort. Lightweight scarves for casual and office wear, thick/woolen scarves for winter.
styleTip: Match colors or patterns with main outfit.

name: Rings
desc: Gold, silver, and imitation rings. Minimal rings for office, statement rings for parties, traditional designs for ethnic wear.
styleTip: Coordinate rings with other jewelry; avoid over-accessorizing.

name: Sneakers
desc: Casual and comfortable footwear. Perfect with jeans, shorts, casual dresses, or athleisure. Best for everyday wear and travel.
styleTip: Choose neutral colors for versatility; bold colors for statement looks.

name: Heels
desc: Elevate your style with classic or modern heels. Suited for formal wear, dresses, skirts, and party outfits.
styleTip: Block heels for comfort, stilettos for elegance.

name: Flats
desc: Simple yet stylish footwear for long walks. Best with casual outfits, dresses, or office wear for comfort.
styleTip: Pointed flats add elegance; round flats for a relaxed vibe.

name: Boots
desc: Sturdy and fashionable boots. Ideal for winter, casual wear, or rugged outdoor outfits. Can be paired with jeans, skirts, or dresses.
styleTip: Ankle boots for everyday wear, knee-high for statement or winter protection.

name: Sandals
desc: Perfect for summer and casual wear. Pair with skirts, dresses, shorts, or light pants.
styleTip: Leather sandals for classy look; flip-flop style for relaxed casual wear.

name: Ethnic Footwear
desc: Juttis, mojris, and kolhapuris. Perfect for traditional outfits like kurtas, sarees, or lehengas.
styleTip: Match embroidery or color with outfit; comfortable for long wear.

name: Loafers
desc: Semi-formal slip-ons. Ideal for office, semi-casual wear, and smart casual outfits.
styleTip: Neutral colors suit most outfits; leather loafers elevate the look.

name: Flip Flops
desc: Lightweight slippers for casual home and beach wear. Best paired with shorts, swimwear, or casual summer outfits.
styleTip: Bright colors for playful look; simple tones for everyday wear.

name: Bob Cut
desc: Chic and manageable short hairstyle. Suits oval and heart-shaped faces. Great for casual, office, or party looks.
styleTip: Can be straight or slightly wavy; use light texturizing spray for volume.

name: Layered Cut
desc: Adds volume and movement to hair. Suitable for all face shapes, especially round and square faces.
styleTip: Layers can be subtle or bold; works well with curls or straight hair.

name: Pixie Cut
desc: Bold, low-maintenance style. Best for oval and heart-shaped faces. Perfect for confident, statement-making looks.
styleTip: Use light styling cream for a sleek or textured look.

name: Braided Styles
desc: Versatile braids for casual, festive, or formal occasions. Works for all hair lengths but best on medium to long hair.
styleTip: Add accessories like beads or ribbons for festive looks.

name: Ponytail Variations
desc: High, low, and side ponytails. Suitable for all face shapes. Ideal for daily wear, office, or sports.
styleTip: Add hair ties or scrunchies; volumize crown for elegance.

name: Curly Styles
desc: Natural curls or styled waves. Best for oval, round, and square faces. Perfect for playful, casual, or party looks.
styleTip: Use curl-defining cream and avoid excessive brushing.

name: Bun Styles
desc: Messy, low, and high buns. Suitable for oval, heart, and round faces. Great for formal, casual, or festive events.
styleTip: Add pins or accessories for elegance; loose strands soften the face.

name: Straightened Hair
desc: Sleek and polished style. Works best on oval and heart-shaped faces. Ideal for office, casual, and formal events.
styleTip: Use heat protectant; add shine serum for a polished finish.

name: Spring Pastels
desc: Soft pastel outfits inspired by blooming season. Best for light to medium body types and casual/outdoor occasions.
styleTip: Pair with neutral accessories; mix and match soft colors for a fresh look.

name: Summer Linen
desc: Light, breathable fabrics perfect for hot weather. Suits all body types. Ideal for casual outings or vacations.
styleTip: Choose loose-fitting silhouettes; minimal accessories keep it airy.

name: Monsoon Wear
desc: Quick-dry clothes and waterproof accessories. Best for all body types. Perfect for rainy days and outdoor events.
styleTip: Use waterproof footwear; carry a stylish umbrella.

name: Autumn Shades
desc: Warm colors and cozy textures. Suits medium to larger body types for layering. Ideal for casual and semi-formal events.
styleTip: Mix textures like wool and cotton; stick to earthy tones for layering.

name: Winter Knits
desc: Layered knits and woolens for warmth. Best for all body types. Great for casual, office, or festive occasions.
styleTip: Pair with boots or scarves; use fitted layers under bulkier knits.

name: Festive Glam
desc: Sparkling outfits and bold styles for celebrations. Suits medium to tall body types. Perfect for parties, weddings, and festivals.
styleTip: Use statement jewelry; bold colors like red, gold, and metallics enhance festive vibes.

name: Wedding Season
desc: Designer lehengas, sarees, and sherwanis. Best for medium to tall body types. Ideal for wedding events and formal celebrations.
styleTip: Balance heavy embroidery with minimal accessories; opt for fitted silhouettes for elegance.

name: Summer Florals
desc: Flowery prints in dresses and kurtis for a breezy vibe. Works well for slim to medium body types. Ideal for casual, brunch, or outdoor parties.
styleTip: Pair with light sandals; avoid overly busy prints on petite frames.
